simplify_nq_example: simplify a Natural Questions example by converting HTML tokens to plain text and removing byte offsets
get_nq_tokens: get blank-separated tokens from a simplified Natural Questions example document text
clean_token: clean a token by replacing blanks with underscores for HTML table cell tokens
remove_html_byte_offsets: remove start_byte and end_byte fields from an NQ annotation span dictionary
clean_annotation: clean an NQ annotation by removing HTML byte offsets from long and short answers
